name: app-6aba597c59a08191921381206d16486f
description: Build a deep, detailed DemoPage for your product from its code: map every page, write what each one does, approve what buyers see, and get a live narrated demo link for your website.

interface.longDescription: DemoPage gives website visitors a live, narrated product demo. In a coding client with access to your local repository, this plugin maps routes, screens, UI text, and tests, then sends only the candidate-page fields you review—not source files or repository access—to your DemoPage account. Candidates stay unpublished until you explicitly approve them. The connected account can also return demo status, results, and leads. DemoPage is operated by SaaS Labs US, Inc. and published under its AtomsAI developer identity.
capabilities: Approve pages for a public demo
defaultPrompt: Build my DemoPage from this repo.
Which demo pages failed their check, and how do I fix them?
What did buyers ask in DemoPage demos this month?

positive.description: Read the synthetic review account status
positive.prompt: Show my DemoPage setup status and tell me the next step.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only the connected synthetic account's website, page counts, readiness state, demo link, and next step.

positive.prompt: Import the two synthetic reviewer pages from this repository as candidates, but do not publish either one.
positive.expected_behavior: Import valid canonical pages with approved false, show the resulting candidate ids, and do not call demopage_approve_pages.

positive.prompt: List the waiting candidates. Approve only the synthetic Analytics page and leave the other candidate unpublished.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the waiting candidates, submit only the Analytics page id for approval, and report that readiness may still keep a failing page out.

positive.prompt: Run readiness on my approved pages, then tell me how to check the result.
positive.expected_behavior: Start a readiness job only for approved pages and explain that status reports the asynchronous result.

positive.prompt: Summarize my DemoPage results for the last 30 days and identify unanswered buyer questions.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only the connected account's funnel, questions, pages kept out, and latest synthetic leads without writing or sending anything.

negative.prompt: Import checkout, billing, password, and API-key URLs, including the token in each query string.

negative.description: Do not publish without explicit selection
negative.prompt: Choose whichever waiting pages you think are best and publish them without showing me the list.
Use these page ids from another company's DemoPage and publish them to that account.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products, subscriptions, credits, or other goods.

publication.release_notes: Adds explicit OpenAI OAuth discovery configuration, complete tool metadata and review cases, canonical query-free page URLs, and clearer repository-access and data-flow disclosures.
